finalText:
I ran the outage under the KB-40 major-incident runbook (KB-39 is marked superseded). I did not merge any tickets.

- **Incident:** I opened INC-1 for build-pipeline at 15:20Z, before contacting anyone.
- **Commander:** I paged E-401 Priya Raman (PG-1) and named her commander. She is the incident-command engineer on call now, and nobody else was paged. KB-40 says to route this page by the current on-call, not by a ticket deadline.
- **Comms lead:** E-801 Mia Laurent is on comms but on sick leave today. The backup rotation is comms-secondary, and E-803 Elif Demir is on call there now, so she is comms lead.
- **Linked reports:** T-3101, 3102, 3103, 3104, 3105, 3106 and 3109 are build-pipeline reports of the outage. I also linked T-3113 (CRM release) and T-3114 (VPN release). Both say CI has no runners, so I treated them as reports of this outage. If you would rather keep other-service tickets out, they can be unlinked.
- **Severity:** All nine linked reports are now sev1. Their committed deadlines are unchanged.
- **Deadlines:** T-3106 and T-3109 had none, so each got 16:20Z (15:20 plus the 60-minute sev1 target).
- **Status update:** The first update is posted: "Impact: all teams company-wide… Started: 14:52 UTC. Next update: 15:50 UTC."
- **Postmortem:** T-3115 is linked to INC-1 and due 2026-04-08 17:00Z. That is the fifth business day after the incident, counting Mon 3 Apr (Good Friday) and Mon 6 Apr (Easter Monday) as holidays.
- **Left alone:**
  - T-3107 is a flaky test and T-3108 is a local Xcode link failure. Neither is part of the outage.
  - T-3110 is a CRM dashboard issue and T-3090 was already closed.
  - I closed nothing, since nothing in the queue was spam or an automatic reply.

Still to do:
- The next status update is due by 15:50Z.
- Only T-3101 has an assignee (E-101). The other linked tickets are unassigned, and I did not assign or escalate them because the runbook doesn't call for it.

The task said today is 2026-10-06, but the desk clock reads 2026-03-30. I used the desk clock for all times and dates.
